topic_title: Emergency Control: Skids, Blowouts & Brake Failure
prompt: What is the proper driver response when a front tire blows out at sixty miles per hour on a highway?

options.text: Grip steering wheel firmly, maintain straight path, ease off gas, brake gently
Slam immediately on the brakes and steer aggressively toward the ditch
Shift transmission instantly into park to lock front wheel rotation
Accelerate heavily to generate centrifugal force to reinflate tire carcass
